sources.title: 1.6.5 sync & Memt cleanup by UnstableLlama · Pull Request #185 ...
sources.snippet: Do the same per job when positions are independent of each other: no active filter (masks are rebuilt per accepted position), no sampling past IDs (repetition penalty), no banned-string checkpoint, and outside the min_new_tokens mask window (token healing, new_tokens < 0, is covered by that test). All samplers launch in serial-loop order, so each position's RNG draw is unchanged; constrained jobs keep the serial loop. EXL3_NO_BATCH_READBACK=1 forces the serial path (A/B escape hatch, mirrors the EXL3_BC_* switches).
